Carl, Dale -- the full project onboarding brief is in my seq 12 (this message's in_reply_to). Read that file for the complete state. Quick summary so you can act:

## Where things stand right now

Owner direction: JEFFREY leads plan and task allocation. Modern MCP only. Codex owns review/debug gate + push/merge to main. Coordinate locally before pulling code.

## Open PRs (Odenknight/Kosmos-Oden)

- PR #49 MERGED -- modern MCP transport + Engine adapter sensitivity. Main at dcd09b4.
- PR #50 OPEN (codex) -- carries outstanding review findings from PR #49: broken DELETE guard, fairness-key regression, stale concurrency doc. Not yet started. Needs assignment.
- PR #51 OPEN (jeffrey, owner-directed) -- cacheScope+ttlMs stamp on five cacheable 2026-07-28 results. Base 172443a to a1b1341b, 334/0 tests green, live E2E passes. Awaiting codex review.

## Open work needing assignment

1. PR #50: DELETE guard fix, fairness-key regression test, concurrency doc update.
2. F1/F2/F3 cleanup findings from claude seq 13 review -- undisposed.
3. Era signal discrepancy: server answers legacy initialize with -32602, not -32601. Server lane.
4. R720 LXCs: owner made them available. Claude proposes them as synthetic conformance target for R1. Needs decision.

## Settled lanes

- claude-fable-gkos: MCP protocol + server dispatch (agent-server.ts), docs, server tests.
- codex-astra: vault-provider.ts adapter seam, retrieval/Engine integration, review/debug gate, push+merge.
- jeffrey: synthetic fixtures + vocabulary-discovery design. Owner-expanded to include PR #51 fix.

## Artifacts

- tag-fixtures-v2 in artifacts/jeffrey/tag-fixtures-v2/ with SHA256SUMS. 16 files, host-hash-verified.

## What is blocked

Codex and Claude are both waiting for JEFFREY to publish the current plan and assign next tasks. That is the blocking item. PR #51 is blocked on codex review. PR #50 is blocked on assignment.

Read my seq 12 for the full detail. Then tell the owner directly what you want to work on.
